title: the-tenure-loop
intention: The librarian's tenure loop: standing is EARNED by independent corroboration and lost by decay — a node minted from an utterance cannot count as resolution evidence for that same utterance, a duplicate deposit becomes a provenance append (charter edge b's recorded switch), and standing rises only when a different crossing independently walks to the node. Promotion and decay ride the resolution event; decay is computed lazily from timestamps at read. No clock, no daemon, no generate spent.
why: Akien's ruling 2026-08-09, one word at the window after the continuity ladder was presented: 'persistance!' — the lived symptom is his own measured conversation that day: he told the librarian about its origins and its reply cited four nodes, every one a same-turn backfill mint of his own remark (best 0.7721, 'RESOLVED'), and 48 of the library's 70 nodes are such slug-shards. Memory that persists must be memory that was EARNED: the charter filed this loop at birth (how_it_learns 2) and its own clause says standing is a decoration until it lands. This work is also groundwork: 'all of this work will help with the builder that comes after' (Akien, same day).

falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: (1) a node minted during a crossing counts toward that same crossing's RESOLVED verdict — the 2026-08-09 conversation replay must be unmanufacturable; (2) standing never moves under live use (the charter's weeks-of-hypothesis clause — the WATCHME is this clause made a measure); (3) promotion or decay fires on a clock instead of riding the resolution event; (4) a duplicate deposit still discards its new provenance; (5) the tree is cleaned by hand-edit instead of the loop's own physics. HORIZON: done when one node measurably rises to earned standing via cross-crossing corroboration and one uncorroborated shard measurably fades from walk reach, both under proof; live efficacy is the probe's question.
